hero.title: Because Every Cat Deserves a Future Filled With Love.
hero.text: Feline Fairies is a volunteer-run nonprofit based in St. Augustine, Florida providing shelter, care, and second chances for homeless cats and kittens.

mission.title: Rescue, Rehabilitate, and Rehome
paragraphs: At Feline Fairies, our mission is simple: to ensure every cat has a chance at a life filled with love, safety, and dignity.

Based in St. Augustine, we're a volunteer-run rescue helping cats through rescue, foster care, adoption, socialization, and basic medical care. From tiny kittens to senior companions, we support them until they're ready for their forever families.
We believe every purr, paw, and playful leap is worth fighting for.
mission.imageAlt: A rescued cat relaxing with a person

rescueStory.title: Be Part of Their Rescue Story

items.title: Adopt
items.text: Our Adoption Program matches cats and kittens with loving, committed families. Every cat receives basic medical care, love, and socialization before they're ready for their forever home.

items.title: Foster
items.text: Our Foster Program gives cats and kittens a soft place to land before adoption. Whether you're new to fostering or experienced, we'll guide you every step of the way while they heal and grow.

items.title: Volunteer
items.text: As a volunteer-run organization, we rely on people like you to carry out our mission. Help with events, socialization, transport, and behind-the-scenes support while making a meaningful impact.

donate.title: Help us say yes to more cats.
donate.text: Donations help provide food, basic medical care, supplies, and safe housing for cats in our care.
